```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

required_packages <- c("shiny", "bslib", "ggplot2", "caret", "class",
                       "rpart", "rpart.plot",
                       "plotly", "DT", "scales", "dplyr", "tidyr")
new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
if (length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(class)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

set.seed(123)

# ---- 1. Load + clean -------------------------------------------------------
strava_raw <- read.csv("strava.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
strava <- strava_raw %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  filter(distance > 0, elapsed_time < 30000)
strava$type <- factor(strava$type)

runs <- strava %>% filter(type == "Run")

# ---- 2. Pace tier (binary) -------------------------------------------------
tert <- quantile(runs$average_speed, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1))
runs$pace_tier <- cut(runs$average_speed, breaks = tert,
                     labels = c("Slow","Medium","Fast"), include.lowest = TRUE)

bin_df <- runs %>%
  filter(pace_tier %in% c("Slow","Fast")) %>%
  mutate(
    pace            = factor(as.character(pace_tier), levels = c("Slow","Fast")),
    log_distance    = log1p(distance),
    log_moving_time = log1p(moving_time),
    log_elevation   = log1p(total_elevation_gain),
    rest_ratio      = (elapsed_time - moving_time) / elapsed_time
  )

model_df <- bin_df %>%
  select(pace, log_distance, log_moving_time, log_elevation, rest_ratio)

# ---- 3. Train / test split -------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
idx       <- createDataPartition(model_df$pace, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_set <- model_df[idx, ]
test_set  <- model_df[-idx, ]

num_cols <- setdiff(names(model_df), "pace")
preProc  <- preProcess(train_set[, num_cols], method = c("center","scale"))
train_s  <- predict(preProc, train_set[, num_cols]); train_s$pace <- train_set$pace
test_s   <- predict(preProc, test_set[,  num_cols]); test_s$pace  <- test_set$pace

# ---- 4. Train all three models --------------------------------------------
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = 10, repeats = 5,
                     classProbs = TRUE, summaryFunction = twoClassSummary)

set.seed(123)
cart_fit <- train(pace ~ ., data = train_s, method = "rpart",
                  trControl = ctrl, metric = "ROC",
                  tuneGrid = expand.grid(cp = seq(0, 0.2, 0.01)))

set.seed(123)
knn_fit <- train(pace ~ ., data = train_s, method = "knn",
                 trControl = ctrl, metric = "ROC",
                 tuneGrid = expand.grid(k = seq(1, 21, 2)))

models <- list("CART" = cart_fit, "kNN" = knn_fit)

# Cached test-set predictions for each model
model_eval <- lapply(models, function(fit) {
  pred <- predict(fit, test_s)
  prob <- predict(fit, test_s, type = "prob")[, "Fast"]
  cm   <- confusionMatrix(pred, test_s$pace, positive = "Fast")
  list(
    pred       = pred,
    prob       = prob,
    cm         = cm,
    cm_table   = as.data.frame.matrix(cm$table),
    accuracy   = unname(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
    kappa      = unname(cm$overall["Kappa"]),
    sensitivity= unname(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    specificity= unname(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
  )
})

# Train-set summary for the data tab
train_summary <- bin_df %>%
  group_by(pace) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    mean_distance  = round(mean(distance), 1),
    mean_speed_ms  = round(mean(average_speed), 2),
    mean_pace_min  = round(mean((moving_time/60) / (distance/1000)), 2),
    mean_elevation = round(mean(total_elevation_gain), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------
build_new_obs <- function(distance_m, moving_time_s, elapsed_time_s, elevation_m) {
  data.frame(
    log_distance    = log1p(distance_m),
    log_moving_time = log1p(moving_time_s),
    log_elevation   = log1p(elevation_m),
    rest_ratio      = (elapsed_time_s - moving_time_s) / max(elapsed_time_s, 1)
  )
}

scale_new_obs <- function(new_obs) {
  predict(preProc, new_obs)
}
```

```{r site-ui}
div(
  class = "site-wrap",
  div(
    class = "app-shell",
```

```{r server, include=FALSE}
active_model <- reactive({ models[[input$model_choice]] })
active_eval  <- reactive({ model_eval[[input$model_choice]] })

new_obs <- reactive({
  req(input$in_distance, input$in_moving, input$in_elapsed, input$in_elevation)
  build_new_obs(input$in_distance, input$in_moving,
                input$in_elapsed,  input$in_elevation)
})

new_obs_scaled <- reactive({ scale_new_obs(new_obs()) })

prediction <- reactive({
  fit  <- active_model()
  obs  <- new_obs_scaled()
  pred <- predict(fit, obs)
  prob <- predict(fit, obs, type = "prob")
  list(class = as.character(pred[1]),
       prob_slow = prob[1, "Slow"],
       prob_fast = prob[1, "Fast"])
})

# ---- Predictor page outputs -----------------------------------------------
output$prediction_card <- renderUI({
  p <- prediction()
  cls <- tolower(p$class)
  div(
    class = paste("predict-result", cls),
    tags$p(class = paste("predict-headline", cls), p$class),
    tags$p(class = "predict-sub",
           sprintf("Model: %s   |   P(Fast) = %.1f%%   |   P(Slow) = %.1f%%",
                   input$model_choice, 100*p$prob_fast, 100*p$prob_slow))
  )
})

output$prob_plot <- renderPlotly({
  p <- prediction()
  df <- data.frame(class = c("Slow","Fast"),
                   prob  = c(p$prob_slow, p$prob_fast))
  df$class <- factor(df$class, levels = c("Slow","Fast"))
  pl <- ggplot(df, aes(x = class, y = prob, fill = class,
                       text = paste0(class, ": ", percent(prob, accuracy = 0.1)))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(prob, accuracy = 0.1)),
              vjust = -0.4, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Slow" = "#c2410c", "Fast" = "#0f766e")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Probability") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
  ggplotly(pl, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(margin = list(l = 45, r = 10, t = 10, b = 35))
})

output$agreement_table <- renderDT({
  obs_s <- new_obs_scaled()
  rows  <- lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
    fit  <- models[[nm]]
    pred <- predict(fit, obs_s)
    prob <- predict(fit, obs_s, type = "prob")
    data.frame(Model = nm,
               Prediction = as.character(pred[1]),
               `P(Slow)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * prob[1, "Slow"]),
               `P(Fast)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * prob[1, "Fast"]),
               check.names = FALSE)
  })
  datatable(do.call(rbind, rows),
            options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE),
            rownames = FALSE)
})

output$scatter_plot <- renderPlotly({
  pl_df <- bin_df %>%
    mutate(pace_min_per_km = (moving_time/60) / (distance/1000))
  user_pace <- (input$in_moving / 60) / (input$in_distance / 1000)
  user_df <- data.frame(distance = input$in_distance,
                        pace_min_per_km = user_pace,
                        pace = "Input")
  pl <- ggplot(pl_df, aes(x = distance, y = pace_min_per_km, color = pace,
                          text = paste0("Distance: ", round(distance), " m<br>",
                                        "Pace: ", round(pace_min_per_km, 2), " min/km<br>",
                                        "Class: ", pace))) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(data = user_df, color = "#dc2626", size = 5,
               shape = 8, stroke = 1.4,
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = distance, y = pace_min_per_km,
                   text = paste0("YOUR RUN<br>Distance: ", round(distance), " m<br>",
                                 "Pace: ", round(pace_min_per_km, 2), " min/km"))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Slow" = "#c2410c", "Fast" = "#0f766e")) +
    scale_y_reverse() +   # faster pace = smaller min/km, plot up
    labs(x = "Distance (m)", y = "Pace (min/km, reversed)", color = "Class") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
  ggplotly(pl, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(margin = list(l = 50, r = 10, t = 10, b = 40))
})

# ---- Performance page outputs ---------------------------------------------
output$kpi_cards <- renderUI({
  e <- active_eval()
  card <- function(label, val) {
    div(class = "kpi-card",
        tags$p(class = "kpi-label", label),
        tags$p(class = "kpi-value", val))
  }
  div(class = "kpi-grid",
      card("Accuracy",    sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * e$accuracy)),
      card("Sensitivity (Fast)", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * e$sensitivity)),
      card("Specificity (Slow)", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * e$specificity)),
      card("Cohen's Kappa",      sprintf("%.2f",   e$kappa)))
})

output$cm_breakdown <- renderUI({
  cm <- active_eval()$cm_table
  tp <- if (all(c("Fast","Fast") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Fast","Fast"] else 0
  tn <- if (all(c("Slow","Slow") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Slow","Slow"] else 0
  fp <- if (all(c("Fast","Slow") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Fast","Slow"] else 0
  fn <- if (all(c("Slow","Fast") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Slow","Fast"] else 0
  pill <- function(label, value) {
    div(class = "cm-pill",
        tags$p(class = "cm-pill-title", label),
        tags$p(class = "cm-pill-value", as.character(value)))
  }
  div(class = "cm-grid",
      pill("True Positive (Fast → Fast)", tp),
      pill("False Positive (Slow → Fast)", fp),
      pill("True Negative (Slow → Slow)", tn),
      pill("False Negative (Fast → Slow)", fn))
})

output$cm_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(active_eval()$cm_table,
            options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE),
            rownames = TRUE)
})

output$cm_heatmap <- renderPlotly({
  e   <- active_eval()
  cm  <- as.data.frame(e$cm$table)
  names(cm) <- c("Predicted","Actual","Count")
  cm$Type <- ifelse(cm$Predicted == cm$Actual, "Correct", "Incorrect")
  pl <- ggplot(cm, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = Count,
                       text = paste0("Actual: ", Actual,
                                     "<br>Predicted: ", Predicted,
                                     "<br>Count: ", Count, "<br>", Type))) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), color = "#111827",
              fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d1fae5", high = "#047857") +
    labs(x = "Actual Class", y = "Predicted Class") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
  ggplotly(pl, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(margin = list(l = 50, r = 10, t = 10, b = 40))
})

output$compare_table <- renderDT({
  rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(model_eval), function(nm) {
    e <- model_eval[[nm]]
    data.frame(Model = nm,
               Accuracy    = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * e$accuracy),
               Sensitivity = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * e$sensitivity),
               Specificity = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * e$specificity),
               Kappa       = sprintf("%.2f",   e$kappa))
  }))
  datatable(rows,
            options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE),
            rownames = FALSE)
})

output$varimp_plot <- renderPlotly({
  imp <- varImp(cart_fit)$importance
  imp_df <- data.frame(Variable = rownames(imp),
                       Importance = imp[, 1])
  imp_df <- imp_df[order(imp_df$Importance), ]
  imp_df$Variable <- factor(imp_df$Variable, levels = imp_df$Variable)
  pl <- ggplot(imp_df, aes(x = Importance, y = Variable,
                           text = paste0(Variable, ": ", round(Importance, 1)))) +
    geom_col(fill = "#0f766e") +
    labs(x = "Importance (CART)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
  ggplotly(pl, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(margin = list(l = 100, r = 10, t = 10, b = 40))
})

# ---- Data page outputs ----------------------------------------------------
output$class_summary_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(train_summary,
            options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE),
            rownames = FALSE,
            colnames = c("Pace Class", "n",
                         "Mean Distance (m)",
                         "Mean Speed (m/s)",
                         "Mean Pace (min/km)",
                         "Mean Elevation (m)"))
})

output$full_data_table <- renderDT({
  show_df <- bin_df %>%
    transmute(pace,
              distance = round(distance, 1),
              moving_time, elapsed_time,
              total_elevation_gain,
              average_speed = round(average_speed, 3),
              rest_ratio    = round(rest_ratio, 3))
  datatable(show_df,
            options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollX = TRUE),
            rownames = FALSE)
})

output$dist_plot <- renderPlotly({
  long_df <- bin_df %>%
    select(pace, distance, moving_time, total_elevation_gain, rest_ratio) %>%
    pivot_longer(-pace, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")
  pl <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = pace, y = value, fill = pace)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, outlier.size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Slow" = "#c2410c", "Fast" = "#0f766e")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
  ggplotly(pl) %>%
    layout(margin = list(l = 40, r = 10, t = 30, b = 30))
})
```
